Industries

Supplier invoices that match the order

enterlabs works with purchase orders, delivery notes, supplier invoices and quality certificates, so an invoice is paid when the documents agree.

Book a demoAll industries

The problem

A supplier invoice should be paid only when it agrees with the purchase order, the delivery note and the quality certificate.

Documents: Purchase orders, delivery notes, supplier invoices and quality certificates.

Example checks

Check 1

Match invoice totals to purchase orders.

Check 2

Check delivery notes against the order.

Check 3

Compare supplier invoices with quality certificates for review.

How it works

01

Prepare the data

enterlabs reads purchase orders, delivery notes, supplier invoices and quality certificates and turns them into structured data.

02

Check against agreed rules

It matches invoice totals and quantities to the purchase order and the delivery note, and compares the invoice with the quality certificate.

03

Review and record

A person reviews each flagged item and makes the final call. Every review is recorded.

An example screen

A supplier invoice matched to a purchase order and a delivery note. One quantity difference is flagged for review.
